summary: Senior Product Manager with experience leading payments initiatives at Starling Bank and Revolut. Owned the Faster Payments integration at Starling Bank, cutting settlement failures by 34%, and led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers. Previously launched card controls used by 2.1 million customers at Revolut and reduced chargeback disputes by 18%.
